content.description:
A calendar date, optionally with a time of day — as precise as its source states.

The optional ``time`` carries the UTC offset on its ``tzinfo`` when the source states one
(fidelity, not normalization). Invalid states are unrepresentable by construction: no time
without a date, no offset without a time.

date.description: The calendar date, in ISO 8601 (e.g. 2026-07-07). Always required.
date.title: Date

time.description: The time of day, in ISO 8601 (e.g. 15:40:00, or 15:40:00+02:00 with a UTC offset). Include it only when the source states a time — never invent a time. Keep the UTC offset exactly when the source states one.
time.title: Time
